body: Ribonucleic acid, or RNA, is a family of molecules built from linked units. Messenger RNA can carry a copy of information from DNA to a ribosome. Other RNAs help the ribosome read the message and assemble amino acids in sequence. Some RNAs take part in regulation or catalyze chemical reactions.

An amino acid chain can fold into a shape that enables a protein's function. Proteins can provide mechanical structure, carry molecules or accelerate reactions. Changes in a chain or in its surroundings can change how it folds or functions.
